law.catch_line: When publication once in two newspapers sufficient
law.text: If there are two or more newspapers having general circulation in the locality where a suit or petition described in § 6.2-920 is pending, the court, in its discretion, in lieu of the publication provided for therein or in § 6.2-921, may direct that the list of creditors and the notice, be published once in at least two of the newspapers having general circulation in the locality.
